interpretation: Assignment-based comparison, including failed requests, fallback responses and users with no watches. Ratings describe raters only; missing fees and ratings are unknown. Complete-fee users are a conditional secondary comparison. Tests assume independent users; 95% intervals are approximate and per metric, not joint. No sequential stopping on significance.

plan.treatment_description: Same EASE weights; eligible personalized score minus 0.04 * fee_USD before top 20; unknown fee uses maximum validated snapshot fee for ranking only; unchanged cold-start/popularity policies
plan.exposure: First gateway request in enrollment window; include failed requests by assigned arm
plan.viewing_unit: Distinct user/movie watched strictly after first assignment and before assignment + follow-up
plan.ratings: Latest submitted 1-10 rating per watched movie after its first qualifying watch, within user follow-up

fee_reference.limitation: Recent movie coverage does not guarantee coverage of future watches; unknowns remain unknown.

decision_rule.cost_population: All assigned users; full spending effect requires complete watched-fee coverage
decision_rule.rating_criterion: Lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% rating-difference CI must exceed the negative decline margin
decision_rule.cost_criterion: Full spend per assigned user declines by at least 10%, with its 95% difference CI below zero; 20% is a goal, not a guarantee
decision_rule.missing_fee_criterion: If any watched fees are unknown, the full-spending target is not established; report conditional known-fee estimates separately
decision_rule.interpretation: Fixed before enrollment; no retuning or early stopping based on significance
